$comment: Where contracts/lesser/graphql-schema.graphql came from, stated precisely enough
that anyone can re-derive it without trusting this file.
THE TWO PROPERTIES ARE NOT THE SAME PROPERTY, and conflating them is how a pin
starts certifying something it never checked:
INTEGRITY is offline. `sha256` is the digest of the bytes in this repository.
scripts/audit-graphql-documents.mjs recomputes it before it validates anything,
so a schema edited in the same pull request as the documents it is supposed to
judge fails the build. That check proves the bytes have not drifted HERE. It
proves nothing whatsoever about upstream.
PROVENANCE is `blob_sha1`. It is git's own object id for these exact bytes —
sha1('blob ' + length + '\0' + content) — which is the id equaltoai/lesser
itself records for docs/contracts/graphql-schema.graphql at `ref`. Anyone can
check it in one call, against lesser rather than against us:
gh api repos/equaltoai/lesser/contents/docs/contracts/graphql-schema.graphql?ref=<ref> --jq .sha
git hash-object contracts/lesser/graphql-schema.graphql
Both must print blob_sha1. That comparison is the binding to upstream; the
offline digest is not, and this repository never reports a green offline run as
evidence of provenance.
WHY THERE IS NO NETWORK CHECK HERE. A gate that dereferences the pin at build
time is a gate whose answer depends on GitHub being reachable and on the request
being aimed at the right repository — and the aiming is the part an edit loosens.
The M2 predecessor to this file grew four layers of defence around that one
question and still had to be told, by review, that its pin had been able to
choose its own examiner. The honest small version is this: pin the bytes, record
the upstream object id beside them, check integrity offline, and let the
human-verifiable one-liner above be the provenance step.
MOVING THIS PIN is a contract event, not maintenance. Fetch the file at the new
lesser ref, recompute all three values, and re-run the document validation in the
same commit — a schema bump that is not accompanied by a validated document set
is a claim that nothing changed, made without looking.

inspected.corroborating_source: The only schema delta from the previous pin (cbe9787f) is additive: `Article.renderedHtml: String`, documented in-schema as 'Canonical sanitized HTML. Never fall back to rendering content when this field is unavailable.' This is the read-path counterpart of the renderer authority the ActivityPub path already used, shipped by lesser itself — the upstream gap the M6-era withhold copy blamed is closed by lesser, not worked around here. greater-v0.13.2 (equaltoai/greater-components #1005) consumes the same field in blog normalization. Verified against equaltoai/lesser graph/ and the v1.6.2 tag object; the blob sha matches `gh api repos/equaltoai/lesser/contents/docs/contracts/graphql-schema.graphql?ref=v1.6.2 --jq .sha`.
